Protection Services

Security built around your risk — not a template.

Every engagement is custom-designed around the client's specific threat landscape, operational environment, and risk tolerance. No two protection plans are the same.

Threat & Vulnerability Assessment

A detailed evaluation of physical, digital, and personal vulnerabilities. We identify threats before they materialize and design a mitigation strategy tailored to your risk profile and lifestyle — the starting point for every client.

Who it's forExecutives, families, business owners, and houses of worship who want a clear, professional picture of their risk. Start a free property threat assessment →

Faith-Based Security

Discreet, ministry-sensitive protection for pastors, bishops, evangelists, and houses of worship — protecting without disrupting the sacred environment.

Who it's forChurches, temples, mosques, ministries, and faith leaders.

Active Shooter Response

Comprehensive planning, real-world scenario training, and rapid-response protocols so your people can act decisively under the most extreme conditions.

Who it's forOrganizations, faith-based institutions, and private clients.

Corporate Security

Full-spectrum programs: facility protection, access control, internal investigations, counter-surveillance, and corporate travel security — domestic and global.

Who it's forCompanies, executive teams, and boards.

Residential & Estate Protection

Home security assessments, hardening recommendations, and on-site protective details — including perimeter monitoring, access control, and family safety planning.

Who it's forHigh-net-worth residences, families, and private clients.

Event Security

End-to-end protective coverage with pre-event reconnaissance, crowd management, and a discreet protective presence.

Who it's forGalas, conferences, weddings, faith-based gatherings, and private functions.

Mobile Patrol & Site Security

24/7 mobile patrol and dedicated site security with marked and unmarked vehicles, GPS-tracked routes, and real-time incident reporting.

Who it's forFacilities, properties, and high-value assets.

Travel & Logistics Security

Secure transportation, advance reconnaissance, and route planning. We coordinate with hotels, airports, and venues for seamless, low-profile movement.

Who it's forExecutives, dignitaries, and high-profile individuals traveling at home or abroad.

Surveillance & Counter-Surveillance

Detect and disrupt hostile surveillance targeting principals, residences, or business operations — covert observation, technical sweeps, and electronic counter-measures.

Who it's forPrincipals and businesses concerned about being watched or targeted.

Training Programs

Field experience combined with classroom instruction — security operations fundamentals, defensive tactics, and threat response in an expert-led, certification-track program.

Who it's forSecurity teams, staff, volunteers, and aspiring security professionals.

FAQ

Common questions

What areas do you cover?

We're headquartered in Aberdeen, New Jersey and operate nationwide and internationally, with teams positioned for rapid deployment.

How much does private security cost?

Every engagement is custom-quoted. Pricing depends on scope, number of personnel, duration, location, and threat level. After a confidential consultation and risk assessment you'll receive a plan and quote built for your situation — no obligation.

How quickly will you respond?

All inquiries receive a response within 24 hours to schedule a private consultation, and a 24/7 emergency line is available at (908) 601-3176. If you are in immediate danger, call 911.

Is my inquiry confidential?

Yes. All inquiries are held in strict confidence, and discretion is built into every operation.

Who are your security specialists?

Most of our specialists have law enforcement and/or military backgrounds. The company is led by founder Storm Colleton, a former New Jersey State Police officer and certified tactical defense instructor.

Do you work with churches and ministries?

Yes — faith-based security is a specialty, including protection for pastors, bishops, and evangelists, house-of-worship security, threat assessments, and cultural sensitivity training.

Do you offer training for our staff or security team?

Yes. We offer active shooter response planning and scenario training, plus programs covering security operations fundamentals, defensive tactics, and threat response.

Are you licensed?

Yes — Storm Colleton & Associates is licensed and certified. [License type & number]
